name: Thermo Nunc 150628 12 well multidish
author: Ramona Optics
notes: Thermo Scientific Nunc Cell-Culture Treated Multidish, 12 round wells (3 x 4), Nunclon Delta surface, clear polystyrene, flat well bottom, sterile, with lid. 150628 is individually packed (1/pk; 75/case on the product page, 400/case in the older Nunc multidish sheet). Thermo sells the 12-well multidish format also non-treated (150200, 1/pk, 75/case), with Nunclon Supra (140681), with UpCell (174900) and as Nunclon Sphera (174931, which states a 3.8 cm2 culture area rather than 3.5 cm2); none of their product pages links this drawing, so they are not claimed to share this mould and their surfaces are not listed. SOURCE: Thermo Fisher (Nunc, Roskilde) drawing 2741, version 10, page type -C, 'Bottom part for Multidish 12, Main dimensions', change order CC-1181, valid from 2008-01-29, scale 1:1 on A3. Thermo's own product page no longer links it (it links the 6-, 24- and 48-well multidish drawings instead); the drawing_reference is a distributor-hosted copy (Dominique Dutscher SAS, their item 055428, watermarked with their name) of Thermo's document, whose PDF metadata names the file 150628_2741-C.pdf. From 2741: length 127.6 +0.25/-0.2 mm (A), width 85.3 +/- 0.3 mm (B), height 18.9 mm (C), well bottom diameter 21.0 mm (E), well depth 15.7 mm from the rim to the well floor (F), and the well centres (D) dimensioned from the plate's centrelines: 13.5 and 40.5 mm along the length, and 27.0 mm from row B, which lies on the width centreline, to row A. So the pitch is 27.0 mm in both axes and the grid is centred. A1 is derived from those printed values: 127.6 / 2 - 40.5 = 23.3 mm from the left edge and 85.3 / 2 - 27.0 = 15.65 mm from the top edge; checks: 23.3 + 3 x 27.0 = 104.3 mm leaves a 23.3 mm far margin, 15.65 + 2 x 27.0 = 69.65 mm leaves 15.65 mm. The product page gives 128 x 86 mm (rounded) and 'SBS Standard' format. Section A-A is drawn turned on its side with the resting plane on the left; the 21.0 mm diameter is dimensioned at the floor end of the well and is recorded as the bottom diameter. The walls have the 1.5 degree general draft, but no opening diameter is printed, so diameter_top is left out. The 3.5 cm2 culture area Thermo states (a 21.1 mm disc) agrees with a 21.0 mm floor. Depth 15.7 mm and height 18.9 mm are both measured to the rim plane, so the well floor surface sits about 3.2 mm above the resting plane; no bottom thickness, bottom elevation, wall thickness or refractive index is printed, so none is recorded. Working volume 2 mL per well from the product page and Thermo's multidish tables. SKIRT: the plan view draws the outer (skirt) edge with three corners cut at 45 degrees (top left beside A1, bottom left and bottom right) and the top right corner rounded; none of the four is dimensioned. The chamfer sizes are estimated from the drawing, assumed to scale: scaled against the printed 127.6 mm and 85.3 mm on the same view (about 46.3 px/mm at 1200 dpi; the printed 13.5 and 40.5 mm centre dimensions scale to within 1%), the chamfer lines run at 45 degrees and cut 6.8 mm (top left), 7.0 mm (bottom left) and 7.2 mm (bottom right) off each adjacent edge; the outline records 7.0 mm on all three, uncertain by about +/-0.3 mm, with sharp chamfer ends (the drawing blends them with small fillets of roughly 1 mm, which move the edge by under 0.3 mm). The rounded top right corner scales to a radius of about 2.5 mm (+/-0.5 mm). The skirt height and the upper body are not dimensioned either, and are likewise estimated from the drawing, assumed to scale (against the printed 18.9 mm height and the 127.6 / 85.3 mm footprint): the outer wall runs at full width from the resting plane to a step at 12.0 mm (+/-0.3 mm; 11.9 mm in the end view and section A-A, 12.2 mm in the front view), then steps inward to a narrower upper body up to the 18.9 mm top. The upper body's silhouette in the front view, end view and section A-A sits 1.6 mm inside the skirt at both ends and 1.3 to 1.6 mm inside it along the long sides; upper_outline records the skirt outline offset inward by 1.5 mm all round (+/-0.3 mm), keeping the same 45 degree chamfers at the three cut corners (the plan view draws the upper body's corner lines parallel to the skirt's) and a concentric radius of about 1.0 mm at the top right. The upper wall's top outer edge is bevelled, about 0.6 mm over the top 1.8 mm, so the rim's top edge, which the plan view draws, lies about 2.0 mm inside the skirt. Small ribs bridge the step about 10 mm from the corners; they are not recorded. No flange width is printed, so thickness is not recorded. Clear polystyrene bottom (bottom_color clear): the plate can be imaged through the bottom. Dimensions are in meters.
